channel.title: The Dig — Application benchmarks
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Application benchmarks preset. Today's ranked reading list leads with 2611.25579 on syndrome-based gate-error amplification for drift recalibration and 2611.23786 on an MLIR-based circuit-cutting workflow for wider circuits on small noisy QPUs, then moves through skims on real-time QEC hardware and control: 2611.26447 for an FPGA neural decoder, 2611.24328 for Pauli-frame tracking, 2611.23919 for minimal-control fault-tolerant architecture, 2611.24687 for reaction-depth Boolean logic, 2611.26395 for non-binary detector error models, and 2611.24044 for compiled Clifford-augmented matrix product state QEC simulation.
